admission.justification: Realized across site/package.json, config.mts, tokens.css and all four Vue components and required for the Phase 4 static site family; prevents broken script-off math or prose, double-prefixed base URLs, navbar title overflow past the 272px sidebar divider, keyboard focus traps and dark-dashboard aesthetic drift.

applicability: Static VitePress site configuration, package manifest, light-monograph CSS tokens and four globally registered Vue components under site/.
conditions: site/docs/.vitepress/config.mts enables markdown.math: true (paired with markdown-it-mathjax3 in site/package.json and site/package-lock.json), cleanUrls: true, appearance: false, VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, full HTML title 'Riemann Hypothesis Proof Explainer' and themeConfig.siteTitle 'RH Proof Explainer'.

site/docs/.vitepress/theme/tokens.css constrains .VPNavBarTitle .title, .VPNavBarTitle.has-sidebar .title and their inner > span with single-line nowrap/ellipsis and min-width: 0 framing so the navbar title stays inside the 272px sidebar header with zero horizontal overflow across desktop and narrow viewports.

VerificationBanner (defaulting repoLayout to 'condensed' for live comparator.json/GUIDE.md/INDEX.md links and preserving 'legacy' comparator/ and verification/NOTES.md links), ConceptReveal, ConceptHover and ZoomTabs preserve full script-off and print readability, keyboard operation without focus traps and high-contrast non-color-only visual cues.
exclusions: Full 8-pillar interactive Cytoscape/D3 DAG explorer and dark-mode theme toggling are explicitly out of scope for Stage 00.

evidence: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run docs:build + Playwright Look-and-Operate (round-1-evidence.tar.gz)

statement: The VitePress site configures build-time MathJax 3 SVG math (markdown.math: true + markdown-it-mathjax3 + committed package-lock.json), configurable VITEPRESS_BASE defaulting to /ar-rh-proof-skeleton/, compact navbar siteTitle 'RH Proof Explainer' framed inside the 272px sidebar header while retaining full HTML title 'Riemann Hypothesis Proof Explainer', an editorial light palette, and accessible script-off-readable VerificationBanner (supporting condensed and legacy repoLayout links), ConceptReveal, ConceptHover, and ZoomTabs components.
title: Editorial light VitePress shell, MathJax 3 SVG and script-off Vue components
